It is believed that '''Remnant '''is a pure and complete form of frequency energy, and the information it records can transcend time and space to exist in a stable form.<ref>Glossary, Remnant Energy
:''A form of pure energy with complete frequencies. The information it carries transcends time and space, enduring in a stable, unchanging state.''</ref>

==Sources of Remnant Energy==
The [[Etheric Sea]] contains condensed Remnant Energy,<ref>Glossary, Etheric Sea
:''A planet-wide phenomenon born from an anomalous Lament event. It now blankets Solaris's sky. Research suggests it is composed of extremely high-density Remnant Energy. Since its appearance, all of Solaris's space exploration has been brought to a complete standstill.''</ref> which consequently leads to the creation of new [[Tacet Field]]s,<ref>{{Quest|Utterance of Marvels: I}}
:'''''Yangyang:''' The wind has brought us a warning. The Etheric Sea is converging. It seems a new Tacet Field is taking shape.''</ref> as well as the phenomenon known as [[Retroact Rain]].<ref>{{Quest|Rewinding Raindrops}}
:'''''Aalto:''' The Retroact Rain is essentially a form of condensed Remnant Energy from the Etheric Sea.''
:'''''Aalto:''' Various events across space and time from every dimension are recorded in the form of Remnant Energy.''</ref>

Transdimensional spaces where Remnant Energy is abundant are known as the {{Lang|[[Sonoro Spheres]]|zh=索诺拉}}.<ref>Glossary, Sonoro Sphere
:''Transdimensional spaces where Remnant Energy is abundant are known as the Sonoro Spheres.''</ref> The Sonoro Sphere is an important source of information for humanity to understand the history and civilization of [[The Lament]].

==Applications of Remnant Energy==
[[Tacetite]] is substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy,<ref>[https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com/en/main#lore Wuthering Waves Official Website], Remnant
:''In their studies of Waveworn Phenomena, scientists discovered "Tacetite" — a substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy. The Tacetite can be made into potent weapons for Resonators to combat Tacet Discords. Transdimensional spaces where Remnant Energy is abundant are known as the Sonoro Spheres.''</ref> and has been crafted into weapons that can damage [[Tacet Discord]]. Similarly, [[Resonant Calcite]] is an excellent conductor of Remnant Energy.<ref>[[Resonant Calcite]], Item Description
:''A mineral soaked in the waters of Nimbus Sanctum, its surface gleaming with an iridescent sheen. Resonant Calcite is an excellent conductor of Remnant Energy.''</ref>

The [[Shorekeeper]] is an entity of high-purity Remnant Energy crystals.<ref>[[Shorekeeper/Backstory#Forte Examination Report|Shorekeeper's Forte Examination Report]]
:''The Second Instance (also known as the Shorekeeper) is composed entirely of high-purity Remnant Energy crystals.''</ref>

==Trivia==
*[[Baizhi|Baizhi's]] [[Resonance Spectrum Patterns|Resonance Spectrum Pattern]] shows a certain level of similarity with the fluctuations of Remnant Energy.<ref>[[Baizhi/Backstory#Forte Examination Report|Baizhi's Forte Examination Report]]
:''Resonator Baizhi's Resonance Spectrum Pattern does not resemble any known frequencies. However, it shows a certain level of similarity with the fluctuations of Remnant Energy, and it possesses a strong Syntony Response with "You'tan," her Remnant Creature.''</ref>
